root.--font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Noto Sans KR", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

projectPrimitives.--palette-gray-00: SEED palette (rootage color.yaml). gray-00 … 1000 and every hue 100 … 1000 are adaptive: .dark swaps the ramp, static-* stays.
projectPrimitives.--fg-brand: Foreground roles ($color.fg.*): ink by emphasis, then tone
projectPrimitives.--bg-brand-solid: Background roles ($color.bg.*): layer-basement < layer-default < layer-floating, tone solid / weak, pressed pairs
projectPrimitives.--stroke-brand-solid: Stroke roles ($color.stroke.*): neutral-muted is the hairline, neutral-weak the field outline, focus-ring blue-600
projectPrimitives.--manner-temp-l1-bg: Daangn-only: 매너온도 levels l1 … l10 (bg / text)
projectPrimitives.--shadow-s1: Elevation ($shadow.s1 … s3); .dark redeclares the heavier theme-dark shadows
projectPrimitives.--radius-r0-5: Radius scale ($radius.r0_5 … r6, full). --radius is r3 (12px), so shadcn sm/md/lg/xl land on r2 / r2_5 / r3 / r4.
projectPrimitives.--spacing-global-gutter: Spacing roles ($dimension.spacing-x / spacing-y). The 4px grid itself is Tailwind's --spacing.
projectPrimitives.--dimension-x0-5: Dimension scale ($dimension.x0_5 … x16). Component snippets read these exactly as SEED recipes do.
projectPrimitives.--feedback-scale: Pressed scale feedback (base.css): 1 at rest; .seed-scale-feedback derives (h - 2) / h from --seed-element-height set by components/scale-feedback.ts. Safe areas for sheets and bottom bars.
projectPrimitives.--breakpoint-sm: Viewport widths (css/breakpoints): base 0, sm 480, md 768, lg 1280, xl 1440
projectPrimitives.--text-t1: Type scale t1 … t14 ($font-size / $line-height). rem steps follow the user's font scale (SEED clamps them at 0.8 … 1.5x); -static steps are fixed px.
projectPrimitives.--text-title: Type roles: SEED textStyle (screenTitle / articleBody / articleNote) + component label defaults
projectPrimitives.--control-height-xs: ActionButton xsmall 32 (pill) / small 36 / medium 40 / large 52; label bold
projectPrimitives.--field-height: TextInput / SelectTrigger outline: medium 40 r8, large 52 r12; stroke 1px → 2px on focus / invalid
projectPrimitives.--chip-height-sm: Chip small 32 / medium 36 / large 40, pill; ControlChip / ActionChip 32 / 36
projectPrimitives.--list-row-padding-y: ListItem: 12px block, --spacing-global-gutter inline; pressed paints a r10 pill inset 6px
projectPrimitives.--tab-height: Tabs: medium 44 / small 40, 2px indicator; SegmentedControl 4px track, 34 items, pill
projectPrimitives.--switch-width: Selection marks: Switch 52x32 (thumb 26, 3px inset); Checkbox / Radio 20 medium, 24 large, r4
projectPrimitives.--dialog-radius: Overlays: Dialog r20 max 480, AlertDialog 272, BottomSheet top r24 max 480, Menu r20 240 / s3, Snackbar r8
projectPrimitives.--field-stroke: Component colour roles (SEED component specs, never a palette literal)

dark.--palette-gray-00: SEED theme-dark palette. Only steps that differ from theme-light are redeclared.

projectUtilities.--color-fg-neutral: SEED role utilities (same names as @seed-design/tailwind4-theme: text-fg-neutral, bg-bg-layer-default, border-stroke-neutral-muted)
projectUtilities.--text-t1: Type scale + roles: text-t5, text-title, text-body … (runtime values live in :root)
